value.rationale: A natural memory-size parameter in noisy Anderson extrapolation has a previously unquantified in-source exact p-moment existence boundary: full memory has infinite mean; one below full memory has finite mean and infinite variance; higher codimension has finite variance. This explains why rare nearly singular mixing coefficients can invalidate expected-error metrics even when typical runs appear stable and distinguishes ineffective fixed output damping from sufficient fixed ridge regularization. The sharp all-memory design classification is mathematically motivated and not a mere arbitrary parameter substitution.
